title: IDENTIFYING AND MITIGATING GENDER CUES IN ACADEMIC RECOMMENDATION LETTERS: AN INTERPRETABILITY CASE STUDY

bias_targets.methodology: Training Transformer-based text classifiers (DistilBERT, RoBERTa, Llama 2) on explicitly de-gendered academic letters of recommendation to predict applicant gender, and using interpretability techniques like SHAP and TF-IDF to identify and quantify the impact of implicit gender cues.
